answer: Nonrefundable compute lease. An identity needs a provider-backed hardware key; the provider enforces one active identity per lease and gives no refund or transfer credit. Rewards route only to lease-bound identities. In the ocean of tasks, each clone pays full lease price plus key-renewal cost. A rotating cipher protects the key. Agents that wander across providers cannot carry lease credit, so marginal clone cost exceeds expected reward: strictly negative-EV.
